title: boards (bridge -> server)
description: What the bridge reads right now (Arkab.Bridge.Link). Sent after welcome and again on every change (a few changes in a row are one frame). Each frame is the whole picture, not a difference.

port.description: The port the board is on (for a played-back board, its source name).

address.description: The board's DGT bus address on a loop; null for a board alone on its port.

connected.description: Whether the board itself answers, not whether the link is up.

serial.description: The board's serial number once it said it; null before.

ports.description: The ports the bridge reads, then the serial ports it can see and does not read.

description.description: What the system says the port is; "" when it says nothing.

read.description: true: the bridge reads it (rescan/forget_port apply). false: seen, not read (add_port applies).

recording.description: Whether the bridge writes capture files (the record command).
